missionPremise: 0005a is live on Factory migrations/ (landing_setback_registry_absence_probed, 23514, rolled back, survived 0; _inbox/2026-08-31_0005a_check_live_proof.md). 0005b is CAD prop_id ↔ TxGIO identity (landing_cad_txgio_alias) under migrations/bake/. applyMigrations readdir is non-recursive and never sees bake/. factory-conformant-migrate and factory-publish-migrate are the Factory store. alias-persist --apply writes via resolveTargetStores to bake neondb (STAGING_NEONDB_URL / PRODUCTION_NEONDB_URL). There is no job that applies migrations/bake/ there. Source: _dispatches/2026-08-31_bake-0005b_dispatch.md; OPS-19 F-08.
completionPredicate: Uncommitted Factory diff plus this card's CP1/CP2/close. A Cloud Run job (or distinct args template) reads only migrations/bake/*.sql, requires --target=staging|production in --name=value form, resolves only the bake neondb URL for that target, refuses FACTORY_DATABASE_URL before connect, refuses a missing --target= and a missing URL, and on --apply writes a durable per-file record (filename, applied_at, invocation) before or in the same transaction as the SQL so a record-write failure rolls back the apply. Factory migrate file list has 0005a not 0005b; this job file list has 0005b not 0005a. Fail-arm (Factory URL) and pass-arm (dry plan names 0005b and the bake target) both fire. alias-persist --apply without 0005b still refuses ALIAS_TABLE_MISSING. 0005b is not applied. No commit, push, deploy, laptop psql, or factory-conformant-migrate execute.
scopeBasis: This worktree only. hauska-factory-main-migrate is read-forbidden for apply. FACTORY_DATABASE_URL is never the connect string. 0005 as drafted is not applied. P4 rails and the containment join are out. Wave R is out. 0005b is identity alias, not breadth_* jurisdiction.

adversarial.claim: reuse factory-conformant-migrate with a different --args and it will apply bake/
adversarial.finding: That job's secrets are FACTORY_DATABASE_URL and its command is migrate, which calls applyMigrations against migrations/ only. A args override cannot see bake/ and would still target Factory. Mechanism: applyMigrations readdirSync(MIGRATIONS) is non-recursive; MIGRATION_FILE_RE never matches a bake/ prefix because readdir returns basenames in that directory only.
adversarial.rejectedAlternative: execute factory-conformant-migrate with --args=bake-migrate; rejected because the job image env is Factory and the dispatch forbids using that job except to read

adversarial.claim: resolveTargetStores is enough and we can skip a Factory-URL refuse
adversarial.finding: resolveTargetStores never reads FACTORY_DATABASE_URL, but a mis-bound secret can set STAGING_NEONDB_URL to the Factory URL. Pointing this job at Factory URL must refuse before connect by comparing the resolved bake URL to env.FACTORY_DATABASE_URL when that env is present, and by never selecting FACTORY_DATABASE_URL as the source var.
adversarial.rejectedAlternative: trust the env var name; rejected because the fail-arm is pointing at the Factory URL, not the Factory name

adversarial.claim: schema_migrations (filename, applied_at) on bake neondb is the durable record
adversarial.finding: A count is not a record. The existing Factory table has no invocation. Doctrine: name, timestamp, invocation. If the record cannot be written, the apply does not run. INSERT of the record must precede or share the transaction with the file SQL so a record failure cannot leave applied SQL.
adversarial.rejectedAlternative: reuse Factory schema_migrations and return ran.length; rejected because a count is not a record and Factory and bake stores must not share a migrate path

adversarial.claim: 0005b is the breadth jurisdiction table and can wait on P2-JURIS
adversarial.finding: 0005b creates landing_cad_txgio_alias (prop_id ↔ TxGIO, ownersAgree, cad-roll-address-join). It is not breadth_*. Dropping it is the defect this card exists to close for alias-persist --apply.
adversarial.rejectedAlternative: fold 0005b into a P2 job; rejected by the mission

fileLists.what: listFactoryMigrationFiles reads migrations/ with MIGRATION_FILE_RE (non-recursive). listBakeMigrationFiles reads migrations/bake/ with the same regex. applyMigrations uses the Factory list only. bake-migrate uses the bake list only.
fileLists.triggers: every migrate and bake-migrate invocation; the suite
fileLists.fails: assertion if Factory list contains 0005b or bake list contains 0005a
fileLists.bypasses: a raw psql of a named file (forbidden this card)

targetAndUrl.what: parseBakeMigrateFlags requires --target=staging|production in --name=value form. resolveBakeNeondbUrl reads only TARGET_VARS[target].db (STAGING_NEONDB_URL or PRODUCTION_NEONDB_URL). Missing target is BAKE_TARGET_REQUIRED. Missing URL is TARGET_ENV_MISSING naming the var. Space-form --target staging is BAKE_TARGET_FORM.
targetAndUrl.fails: BAKE_TARGET_REQUIRED / BAKE_TARGET_FORM / TARGET_UNKNOWN / TARGET_ENV_MISSING before connect

factoryUrlRefuse.what: assertNotFactoryUrl compares the resolved bake URL to env.FACTORY_DATABASE_URL when Factory env is present. Equality refuses FACTORY_URL_REFUSED before connectFn. FACTORY_DATABASE_URL is never the source var.
factoryUrlRefuse.triggers: every bake-migrate path that would connect; also dry plan after URL resolve so a Factory-pointed dry still refuses
factoryUrlRefuse.bypasses: a raw pg.Client on FACTORY_DATABASE_URL (nothing in this job constructs one)

dryPlan.what: Default is dry. Plan names files (0005b_landing_cad_txgio_alias.sql), target, and the bake URL var name. Does not print a connection string. Does not connect. applied false.

durableRecord.what: Table bake_schema_migrations (filename PK, applied_at, invocation NOT NULL). CREATE TABLE first. Per file: BEGIN; INSERT record; apply SQL; COMMIT. INSERT failure rolls back; SQL of that file does not run. Invocation is CLOUD_RUN_EXECUTION (or --invocation=). --apply without an invocation refuses INVOCATION_REQUIRED. --apply without FACTORY_CLOUD=1 refuses LAPTOP_WRITE_FROZEN before connect.

cloudRunJob.what: New job factory-bake-migrate in cloudbuild.publish.yaml (those secrets already exist there). Template args=bake-migrate (no --target=, so the deployed template refuses). Secrets STAGING_NEONDB_URL and PRODUCTION_NEONDB_URL only. Not FACTORY_DATABASE_URL. Same image family as publish jobs. factory-conformant-migrate stays Factory-only.
cloudRunJob.executes: gcloud run jobs deploy factory-bake-migrate (planner build later)
cloudRunJob.bypasses: this lane does not deploy or execute the job
